President Bongbong Marcos Jr. and the heads of concerned government agencies assure the public that the entire government is ready to address the needs of our fellow citizens amid consecutive typhoons and flooding. 

This includes focusing on health, especially diseases that commonly spread during the rainy season, and the education of children affected by class cancellations and the use of schools as evacuation centers. 

Above all, President Marcos said that the government will ensure that we are fully prepared for future typhoons caused by climate change.

Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City | 24 July 2025

#Younggunsph #20thCongress #BagongPilipinas #PBBM

Dumalo si Mayor Joy Belmonte sa pulong ng Quezon City Law and Order Cluster kasama ang mga government agencies bilang paghahanda sa darating na State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. sa Lunes, July 28, 2025.

Nais tiyakin ng Alkalde na patuloy ang koordinasyon ng pamahalaang lungsod sa national government upang matiyak ang safety and security sa gaganaping SONA sa Lungsod Quezon.

Nakibahagi sa pulong sina Chief of Staff Rowena Macatao, ACA Alberto Kimpo, Department of Public Order and Safety head Elmo San Diego, Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office head Bianca Perez, Market Development and Administration Department head Alex Alberto, D2 Action Officer Atty. Bong Teodoro, QC Fire District Marshal FSUPPT. Rodrigo N. Reyes, at Traffic and Transport Management Department head Dexter Cardenas, at mga kawani ng QC Police District.
